name: rsvp-seat
title: RSVP seat decision
purpose: Decide whether an RSVP holds a confirmed seat, joins the waitlist, or needs none.

blocks.text: Tell us who is coming and we'll tell you where you stand.

blocks.label: People in your party, you included

fields.name: party
fields.means: total people in the party, the guest included

meanings.confirmed: Your seats are held. See you there.
meanings.waitlist: You're on the waitlist; we'll write if seats open.
meanings.none: No seat is held for you.

rules.why: a guest who declines needs no seat
a party of nobody takes no seat
the party is larger than the seats left

otherwiseWhy: the whole party fits in the seats left

properties.why: a declined guest never holds a seat
a seat is never promised that is not there

limits: Numbers are whole and not negative.
The party counts everyone, the guest included.
Seats left is read at the time of the RSVP.
